The '''Arenas of Mepha'as Prime''' were a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mepha'as Prime]]. Shortly before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jin-Jin]] won half a million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in the Arenas.<ref name="SOR">{{JournalCite|5|Smugglers of the Outer Rim}}</ref>
